profile.headline: Software Engineer at Youtube
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with a technical and analytical mind.  I earned a B.S. in Computer Science at UC Riverside and have spent the last few years as the IT Administrator at Keystone Electric.  I have experience working with a variety of different tasks, including website design, database management, scripting, networking, and software development.

My main programming language is C++, and over time I have learned several other popular languages such as PHP, SQL, Python, C#, and Visual Basic. Throughout my education and career, I’ve created: algorithms for tasks such as pathing, simulations of real-life scenarios such as an airport’s parking lot, remakes of several classic games, a website for managing members of an association, scripts for crucial tasks such as automated backups, tables and views to organize data in a database, and web applications for business management and report generation.

One of my main hobbies is designing and programming games, and I have made several in my free time. In high school I used an event-driven GUI to create many games, some which were classic remakes and others which are original. I used C++ to make 2D and 3D games as both college assignments and free time projects. During some of these projects I learned to use a modeling program called Blender, so I have some experience creating and working with three-dimensional graphics.
